_comment: FIGURE SOURCES block, the figure at the top of animatebench.html (<bench-sources>). `image` is the full-resolution figure the viewer opens; `display` and `displaySmall` are the web-sized copies the page itself loads. To change the figure, drop a new PNG in assets/bench/ and rebuild the two copies beside it. The four `sources` entries are the figure's own quadrants, in reading order, each tinted like the quadrant it names.
title: Where the diagrams come from
lede: AnimateBench draws its process diagrams from four bodies of published work, so the benchmark spans the drawing conventions of several fields rather than one venue's house style.
alt: Four quadrants around a central Figure Sources hub: AI conference papers, biomedical and bioinformatics journals, arXiv papers, and publicly available datasets, each with its venues and sample diagrams.
